title: Sites
description: Curated landing sites (web/public/data/sites.json). Hand-curated, so it is a bare array without the generated-file envelope; each site cites its own source.

id.description: Unique site id (no units); also the file name in masks/{id}.json and validation/{id}.json.

category.description: Site group (no units): Artemis III candidate region, CLPS lander, international mission, Apollo (equatorial contrast), or demo (synthetic fixture for interface testing).

note.description: One-line plain-language note shown in the UI (no units); may be empty.

source_url.description: URL of the source the coordinates were taken from (no units).
